definitions.explanation: Movable items used in a home or office, such as tables, chairs, desks, shelves, and beds.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{家具|かぐ}を{買|か}った。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しのときに{家具|かぐ}を{全部|ぜんぶ}{買|か}い{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I replaced all the furniture when I moved.

examples.japanese: このアパートは{家具|かぐ}{付|つ}きなので、すぐに{住|す}み{始|はじ}められる。
examples.english: This apartment comes furnished, so you can start living there right away.

notes:
{家具|かぐ} combines {家|か} (house) and {具|ぐ} (tool, implement).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家具|かぐ}を{買|か}う (to buy furniture)
- {家具|かぐ}を{置|お}く (to place furniture)
- {家具|かぐ}{付|つ}き (furnished — of apartments or rooms)
- {家具|かぐ}{屋|や} (furniture store)
- {家具|かぐ}を{組|く}み{立|た}てる (to assemble furniture)

COUNTER:
Furniture is counted with {点|てん} (items) or {個|こ} (pieces). Large furniture may use {台|だい}.
